A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Continuous Adversarial Flow Models and contain complete, readable main text and Appendices A–H. Text and rendered-page comparison support a reliable comparison; all appendix pages are unchanged.

before.justification: V1 reports original ImageNet post-training and training-from-scratch experiments, text-to-image benchmark results, and ablations in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: V2 retains the original ImageNet and text-to-image experiments, quantitative results, ablations, and qualitative analyses.

M1.justification: The CAFM architecture, JVP discriminator, training objectives, regularization, and training procedure in Section 3 and Algorithm 1 are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same ImageNet 256px generation tasks and 512px text-to-image experiments evaluated on GenEval and DPG-Bench. No training or evaluation coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the tables, including FM controls, the ImageNet comparisons in Tables 3–4, and original Z-Image reference results in Tables 16–17.

E3.justification: Training budgets, model configurations, guidance sweeps, samplers, resolutions, and evaluation metrics remain unchanged. The experimental settings in Section 4 and Tables 14–15 are identical.

E4.justification: The hyperparameter and loss-function ablations in Tables 8–12 and Figure 5, normalization analysis in Figure 12, and failure cases in Figure 11 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting remains unchanged, with the same point estimates and training curves. No run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: Section 4.1 corrects the guidance-free JiT+CAFM FID from 4.57 to 3.57. Tables 2, 4, and 13 already report 3.57 in v1 and remain unchanged, establishing a prose correction rather than a new performance gain. Other reported results are unchanged.

T1.justification: Section 2.2 changes the stated mathematical breakdown condition for discrete AFMs from |t-s| approaching zero to |t-s| equal to zero, distinguishing the limiting process from the singular endpoint. The CAFM equations and derivations in Appendices C–E are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same continuous-time adversarial-training contribution, post-training emphasis, and performance claims. The abstract and introduction already give the corrected JiT FID of 3.57 in v1.

C2.justification: Section 2.2 narrows the stated AFM objective-breakdown condition to an exactly zero timestep interval while retaining the warning about increasing instability at small intervals. Interpretations of CAFM results and its limitations, including guidance-free failure cases and computational overhead, are unchanged.

D1.justification: V2 adds a first-page footnote identifying a code repository, absent from v1. Algorithm 1, hyperparameter tables, implementation guidance, and computational-cost information remain unchanged; the PDFs establish the added access pointer, not the repository's contents.

R1.justification: Both versions cite the same 85 works and retain the same research positioning. Numerous references receive publication-venue, year, or author metadata updates, without adding or removing cited works.

P1.justification: V2 makes localized grammar edits in Sections 2.2 and 5, adds the code footnote, and updates bibliographic metadata. The narrative and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The added footnote slightly reflows the first page, and expanded bibliography entries reflow across reference pages. Figure content, tables, plots, captions, and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: V2 resolves the Section 4.1 FID inconsistency with the existing tables, clarifies the discrete-AFM breakdown condition, and adds an explicit code-access pointer. These provide limited improvements in precision and reproducibility documentation while leaving the scientific evidence, method, and acknowledged limitations unchanged.
